options.label: Ask about herbs
options.message: The herbalist leans close and whispers: 'The moss trails are safer before dawn.'

options.label: Ask about the road
options.message: 'The old road is restless. Keep to the shrines and do not chase every omen.'

options.label: Receive a blessing
options.message: The herbalist wraps a bright herb around your wrist and you feel steadier.

options.label: Ask for the route
options.message: The wayfinder circles the stones and points toward the safer pass. 'Take the road with the weaker fog.'

options.label: Ask for advice
options.message: 'If the skies turn gray, the mountain path will be better than the canyon.'

options.label: Ask about the summit
options.message: The guide cups a hand to the wind. 'The ridge is brutal, but the climb is honest.'

options.label: Ask for safety advice
options.message: 'Rest at every spring and never fight two paths at once.'
